extensionDescription.message: Helps you put all standard media shown on pages into a basket and download them easily.

emptyNone.message:
No captured media.
If media is not captured, try a hard refresh with Cmd+Shift+R to bypass the cache.
Note: Content on YouTube, Netflix, etc. is protected and cannot be captured.

emptyPage.message:
No media captured on this page.
If media is not captured, try a hard refresh with Cmd+Shift+R to bypass the cache.
Note: Content on YouTube, Netflix, etc. is protected and cannot be captured.

emptyTab.message:
No media captured in this tab.
If media is not captured, try a hard refresh with Cmd+Shift+R to bypass the cache.
Note: Content on YouTube, Netflix, etc. is protected and cannot be captured.

zipSmartDone.message: Smart selection: $1 items selected and downloaded

zipSmartNone.message:
No selection results (no images or all filtered out)
Smart download works best when downloading comics.
